2/10/2022 Minnesota State Senate

State Government Finance and Policy and Elections Committee
Wednesday, February 9, 2022
10:30 AMLivestream YouTube

Minutes

Present: Senator Mary Kiffmeyer - Chair, Senator Jeff R. Howe - Vice Chair, Senator Jim Carlson, Senator Gregory D. Clausen,
Senator Omar Fateh, Senator Mark W. Koran, Senator David J. Osmek, Senator Eric R. Pratt

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Mary Kiffmeyer called the meeting to order at 10:31a.m. A quorum was present.
S.F. 2957: Senator Kiffmeyer: Retirement annuities payment during employment as a health care worker authorization.

Senator Kiffmeyer moved the A2 Amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment adopted.
Testifiers:
Amy Strenge, Public Employees Retirement Association of Minnesota

Susan Lenezewski, Executive Director, Minnesota Legislative Commission on Pensions and Retirement

Senator Kiffmeyer moved that S.F. 2957, as amended, be recommended to pass. - MOTION PREVAILED.
S.F. 2818: Senator Kiffmeyer: Office of the Attorney General performance of legal services specification.

Senator Kiffmeyer moved the A1 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was adopted.
Testifiers:
Annette Meeks, CEO Freedom Foundation of Minnesota

Lauren Taken-Holtze, Policy Director, Office of the Attorny General

Senator Osmek requested a roll call.

The results are as follows:

Voting in favor: Voting in opposition:
Senator Kiffmeyer Senator Carlson
Senator Howe Senator Clausen
Senator Koran Senator Fateh

Senator Pratt

Senator Osmek

Senator Kiffmeyer moved that S.F. 2818, as amended, be recommended to pass. - MOTION PREVAILED.

The meeting was adjourned at 11:28a.m.
